newsitem.title: USA: West Point cadet denies raping female cadet.
newsitem.headline: West Point cadet denies raping female cadet.

text.p: The West Point cadet accused of raping a woman cadet took the witness stand on Thursday and denied raping the alleged victim, testifying the sex was consensual.
"I felt somebody on top of me," the accused, Cadet James Engelbrecht, 22, a senior from Conroe, Texas, told a military panel of seven senior Army officers hearing the case.
The victim, now 20, says she was raped at the home of another cadet in Stockholm, New Jersey, during the Memorial Day weekend in May 1996.
Engelbrecht disputed the woman's testimony that she was raped, instead saying she was the aggressor in a consensual sex encounter.

"She placed her hand on my boxer shorts. She took her top off. I fumbled with buttons on her pants and she straddled on top of me. I don't know how she got there. I was kind of groggy at the time," he testified.
Witnesses at the trial testified Wednesday the alleged victim was drunk on the night in question.

Among 10 prosecution witnesses who testified Wednesday were women who attended a party at the house on the night of the alleged attack. They said the women was very drunk and became loud during the party.
Another witness, now a lieutenant in the Army, said he was sleeping in a bunk bed below where the attack was said to have occurred. He said he heard giggling and details was scarce.

The alleged victim has testified she was drinking at the time but did not consent to sex with Engelbrecht. An Army doctor confirmed the testimony of the alleged victim, who said she had never had sexual intercourse prior to the incident. He also said he had not seen any bruises on her. She is now on leave from the military academy.

The case is the first of its kind since women began attending the prestigious military school in 1976, West Point authorities said. If found guilty, Engelbrecht could be sentenced to life in a military prison.
The military panel is expected to begin deliberating the case Friday.
